Summary: The sources provide varying estimates for energy consumption per successful agent task. According to IEEE Spectrum, estimates for per-query energy consumption vary, with a figure of 0.34 watt-hours stated by Sam Altman for a single query. Brookings mentions that a "median" text-generation prompt in Gemini apps consumes approximately 0.24 watt-hours of energy. The report from Schneider Electric Sustainability Research Institute uses a figure of 2.9 watt-hours per query. The paper by Oviedo et al. (2026) estimates 0.31 watt-hours for a standard query and 3.91 watt-hours for a long reasoning query. These estimates highlight the variability in energy consumption based on query complexity and model size.
